paper: Towards Universal AI-Generated Image Detection by Variational Information Bottleneck Network (Zhang et al., CVPR 2025)
arxiv_id: none (CVPR 2025 Open Access; no arXiv id). PDF: openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2025/papers/Zhang_Towards_Universal_AI-Generated_Image_Detection_by_Variational_Information_Bottleneck_Network_CVPR_2025_paper.pdf
training_set_in_paper: Two training schemes. (A) GenImage SDv1.4: ImageNet reals + SDv1.4 fakes, ~32,000 images total. (B) ForenSynths: 20-class ProGAN (18,000 LSUN reals + 18,000 ProGAN fakes per class). Backbone = FROZEN CLIP ViT-L/14 image encoder (fix_backbone=True) + VIB head (fc 768->1024->1024->2k, reparametrize mu/std, decode->1 logit). Adam lr=2e-4, bs=256, on V100. Aug = Gaussian blur + JPEG compression (same as CNNSpot/UnivFD, p=0.1). Eval: loadSize=256, CenterCrop(cropSize=224), CLIP normalization (main.py:194-198).

benchmarks.name: Diffusion-source (SDv1.4-trained), AP -- HEADLINE
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 1 (p.5). 'Ours' Average AP = 95.53. Trained on SDv1.4, tested on 15 models (7 DM + GANs/Others). This is the headline GenImage-trained transfer table.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: main.py: CLIPModel(ViT-L/14), CenterCrop(224)+ToTensor+Normalize(CLIP mean/std), model returns (mu,std),logit; logit.sigmoid(); AP=average_precision_score. data_mode='wang2020' (0_real/1_fake). NO OFFICIAL WEIGHTS were runnable in this campaign for the AGID side (see gap_cause).

our_number.note: AGID GenImage-8 subset (the 8 GenImage generators only, not the 15-model superset). registry default = 83.26-83.28 mAP/77.3 acc; gap-closing retrain model_9 = 83.94 mAP/77.6 acc (best, tag=vib_final_g8 2026-06-07). Paper 95.53 is over 15 models incl easy GAN columns; AGID 83.94 is over the harder GenImage-8 (adm/vqdm/midjourney heavy).

benchmarks.gap_cause: No official VIB-Net weights were loaded into the AGID class for a faithful number (the released ckpts are on Baidu/GDrive and were not fetched/key-remapped in this campaign), so AGID has only its from-scratch CLIP-VIB re-impl. The 83.94 vs paper 95.53 gap is (1) different generator set: AGID averages GenImage-8 (8 hard DM+BigGAN gens) while the paper's 95.53 averages 15 models that include several near-100 GAN columns (ProGAN 96.6, CycleGAN 98.4 etc.) inflating the mean; (2) the AGID CLIP-VIB trained on SDv1.4 cannot transfer to adm/vqdm/midjourney (the ceiling noted in REPRODUCED_MODELS_BENCHMARKS.md). A FLAVA-backbone retrain was attempted and did NOT converge (val loss stayed at chance) — but note the paper's own backbone is CLIP ViT-L/14, not FLAVA (confirmed in models/clip_models.py:CLIPModel and models/__init__.py).
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/GenImage_full/test (8 gens). Full 15-model superset (SAN, Deepfake, StyleGAN etc.) partially on disk under AIGCDetectBenchmark/CNNDetection.

benchmarks.name: GAN-source (ForenSynths/ProGAN-trained), AP
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 3 (p.6). 'Ours' Average AP = 93.14. Trained on ProGAN (ForenSynths), tested on 17 models incl CRN/IMLE/SAN + 7 GenImage DMs.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same main.py CLIP-VIB CenterCrop(224)+CLIP-norm; 17-column ForenSynths-style benchmark (the classic UnivFD 19-model layout minus a couple).

our_number.note: AGID ForenSynths-13 with the GenImage-SDv1.4-trained AGID VIB ckpt = 61.71 mAP/57.9 acc (tag=vibnet_retrain_forensynths). NOTE this is the WRONG-direction transfer: AGID only has an SDv1.4-trained VIB, not a ProGAN-trained one, so it is GenImage->GAN transfer, whereas the paper's 93.14 is a ProGAN-TRAINED model. Not a like-for-like comparison.

benchmarks.gap_cause: AGID never trained a ProGAN/ForenSynths VIB checkpoint, so there is no faithful counterpart to the paper's GAN-source 93.14. The 61.71 is the SDv1.4-trained AGID VIB evaluated cross-domain on GAN test sets (expected to be low). To reproduce this table, AGID would need a ProGAN-trained CLIP-VIB run + the official ProGAN weights for a faithful number. Official ProGAN ckpt exists (Baidu/GDrive) but was not fetched.

benchmarks.name: GAN-source (ForenSynths/ProGAN-trained), ACC
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same CLIP-VIB acc@0.5 over 17 generators, ProGAN-trained.
benchmarks.gap_cause: No ProGAN-trained AGID VIB checkpoint and no official ProGAN weights loaded; AGID only logged the SDv1.4-trained variant (see GAN-source AP entry, 57.91 acc cross-domain). No like-for-like acc number was produced.

notes.no_official_weights_loaded: Unlike FatFormer/NPR (official ckpt key-remapped into AGID class), VIB-Net's released checkpoints (SDv1.4 + ProGAN, on Baidu Pan + Google Drive per README) were NOT fetched and loaded for a faithful number. All AGID VIB numbers are from-scratch CLIP-VIB re-implementations trained on SDv1.4.
notes.paper_backbone_is_clip: The paper + official models/clip_models.py use frozen CLIP ViT-L/14, NOT FLAVA. The 'FLAVA headline' in the gap-closing memory note appears to be a misattribution; the convergence failure was on a FLAVA experiment that is not the paper's actual architecture.
notes.metric_note: Paper reports per-generator AP and acc@0.5. AGID reports mAP (mean AP) over GenImage-8; the paper means are over 15 (DM-trained) or 17 (GAN-trained) generators, so AGID's GenImage-8 mAP is not directly comparable to the paper's 95.53/93.14 means.
